name: Lemon Timer
tagline: A classroom timer where every minute is a lemon.
about: A cartoon teacher sits at her desk with a row of lemons. Every lemon is one minute: at the start of each minute she takes a lemon and eats it, bite by sour bite.
When the time is up she walks to the chalkboard and writes your message in NSW Foundation cursive, fetching her step stool for a longer one.
features: Timers from a minute to hours: longer ones bring out crates of lemons
Pause, reset, and +1 minute even while it runs
Your message on the board, on one to three lines
Full screen for the class; the buttons fade away
Saved timers for the ones you use every day

name: Keyboard Display
tagline: A big on-screen keyboard that lights up as you type.
about: Shows a large keyboard on the board. Each key you press lights up and stays lit until the next press, so students can find the same key on their own keyboards.
Shortcuts are spelt out above the keyboard: press Shift + S and it reads Shift + S, then the letter it makes.
features: Every key and shortcut lights up as you press it
Eight themes, and any colour you like for keys, letters and glow
Record a word or sentence and replay it slowly for the class
Full screen for the class; the buttons fade away

name: Handwriting Worksheets
tagline: Print-ready handwriting practice sheets from any text, in NSW Foundation-style print, precursive or cursive.

name: Fizzlets
tagline: A class pet game for teams: each house hatches and raises little creatures, and builds its own stable.
